accepted.text: Candidates may use the "Shoelace" algorithm i.e. $2\times\frac{1}{2}\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\0&5\\-\frac{20}{3}&0\\8&0\end{vmatrix}=2\times\frac{1}{2}\times\left(8\times5--\frac{20}{3}\times5\right)$ Candidates may attempt to find the area of the parallelogram using the determinant eg $\frac{20}{3}\mathbf{i}+5\mathbf{j}$ and $8\mathbf{i}-5\mathbf{j}$ Area $=\left|\det\begin{bmatrix}\frac{20}{3}&5\\8&-5\end{bmatrix}\right|=\left|\frac{20}{3}\times-5-8\times5\right|=\left|-\frac{220}{3}\right|\Rightarrow$ Area $=\frac{220}{3}$
